Title: Manufacturing method of anion exchange membrane catalyst for water electrolysis and anion exchange membrane catalyst for water electrolysis manufactured thereby
Abstract: 본 발명은 지르코늄(Zr)이 도핑된 코발트 탄산염 수산화물[Zr-Co(CH)] 전구체를 열수 방법을 사용하여 탄소섬유에 성장시켜 제1 나노와이어를 준비하는 단계; 상기 제1 나노와이어를 이리듐 이온(Ir3+) 용액에 함침하여 코발트 결정구조네 이리듐원자를 통합하는 단계; 및 인산화 및 환원 공정을 통하여, 제2 나노와이어를 준비하는 단계를 포함하는 음이온 교환막 수전해용 촉매의 제조방법을 제공한다. 상기 제조방법에 의하여 제조된 촉매는 OER 및 HER 반응에 모두 적용될 수 있는 촉매로서, 전자 전달 성능 향상 및 전기화학적 표면적 향상을 통하여 음이온 교환막 수전해 시스템의 효율을 개선할 수 있다.
Applicants: INDUSTRIAL COOPERATION FOUNDATION JEONBUK NATIONAL UNIV

Title: Portable household hypochlorous acid water making instrument
Abstract: The invention discloses a portable household hypochlorous acid water making instrument. According to main points in a technical scheme of the invention, the portable household hypochlorous acid watermaking instrument comprises a bottle body for containing saline water and a power source, wherein the power source is a lithium battery; an electrolysis box is arranged in the bottle body; an openingis formed in the upper end surface of the electrolysis box; the electrolysis box is provided with an anion exchange membrane covering the opening; the upper end part of the anion exchange membrane isprovided with a positive electrolysis sheet, and the lower end of the anion exchange membrane is provided with a negative electrolysis sheet; the negative electrolysis sheet is arranged in the electrolysis box; the positive electrolysis sheet and the negative electrolysis sheet are arranged in parallel, and the distance between the positive electrolysis sheet and the negative electrolysis sheet is0.2-0.4 mm; and a plurality of through holes are formed in the surfaces of the positive electrolytic sheet and the negative electrolytic sheet. According to the design, saline water for electrolyzingNaCl is adopted, and the anion exchange membrane is employed, so sodium ions are isolated, and chloridions and hydroxide ions react with each other to synthesize hypochlorous acid; and the saline water containing NaCl is a household article, so hypochlorous acid water disinfection liquid for household use can be conveniently manufactured by utilizing the hypochlorous acid water manufacturing instrument designed by the invention.
Applicants: NINGBO INDEXAIR MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

Title: SYSTEM FOR CARRYING OUT ELECTROLYSIS
Abstract: The disclosure relates to a system for carrying out electrolysis to produce oxygen and hydrogen. Said system comprises at least two electrolysis devices, and these electrolysis devices can be supplied with an electrolyte by a common electrolyte supply device. Furthermore, these electrolysis devices each have an electrolyte inlet and an electrolyte outlet, which electrolyte inlets and electrolyte outlets are coupled to the common electrolyte supply device to provide an electrolyte stream through each of the electrolysis devices. The system also comprises at least one electronic control device and at least one flow state detection device to detect the flow states of the electrolyte stream through at least one of the electrolysis devices. The control device is designed to control at least one actuator to influence the electrolyte stream through at least one of the electrolysis devices using detection values from the at least one flow state detection device.

Title: SYSTEM FOR REGENERATING SODIUM HYDROXIDE AND SULFURIC ACID FROM WASTE WATER STREAM CONTAINING SODIUM AND SULFATE IONS
Abstract: A waste water treatment system including an electrolysis treatment system and three membrane concentration systems. The electrolysis treatment system includes a first chamber that receives waste water and produces treated waste water, a second chamber that receives first recycled water and produces dilute acid discharge, and a third chamber that receives second recycled water and produces dilute caustic discharge. An anion exchange membrane separates the first chamber from the second chamber. A cation exchange membrane separates the first chamber from the third chamber. The membrane concentration system receives the treated waste water and produces a concentrated aqueous sodium sulfate product and a pure water product. A first thermal concentration system receives the dilute acid discharge and produces first recycled water and a concentrated acid product. The second thermal concentration system receives the dilute caustic discharge and produces second recycled water and a concentrated aqueous sodium sulfate product.

Title: REACTOR THAT PRODUCES HYDROGEN BY REDUCTION OF HYDRONIUM IONS PRESENT IN THE CHEMICAL EQUILIBRIUM IN WATER AND BY OXIDATION OF THE ORGANIC MOLECULES FOUND IN EXCREMENT
Abstract: An electrochemical reactor designed to increase the efficiency of hydrogen production from faeces and urine (excrement) is disclosed. Said reactor comprises two half-cells separated in a selective manner, a membrane systems separating the half-cells (comprising a proton-exchange and an anion-exchange membranes) and a system of electrical bridges that allow two mutually perpendicular electrical fields to be formed, with the electrical field in the horizontal direction between the two half-cells being greater than the vertical electrical field generated within the anode. The half-cells have a configuration of two resistances in series, which allows the potential of each compartment to be controlled in an independent and complementary manner by adjusting the conductivity of the solutions in the half-cells. Said configuration allows the consumption of energy to form hydrogen to be significantly reduced in comparison with conventional electrolytic cells using water in an alkaline medium by combining the chemical processes of electrolysis (anode) and the law of chemical equilibrium (cathode). International patent classification: Electrolytic production of hydrogen or oxygen (C25B1/04) - Production of hydrogen or gaseous mixtures containing hydrogen by decomposition of gaseous or liquid organic compounds (C01B3/22) Technological sector: Chemical processes.

Title: Electrolysis stack
Abstract: Electrolysis stack, including multiple layers that are stacked along a stacking direction, wherein each of the layers includes an anode space with an anode, a cathode space with a cathode and a membrane that separates the anode space and the cathode space from each other, wherein the anode space, the membrane and the cathode space are arranged adjacent to each other in the stated order along the stacking direction, and wherein each of the layers further includes a respective electrically insulating shell that surrounds the anode space and the cathode space so as to enclose the anode space and the cathode space radially with respect to the stacking direction, wherein the shell includes a groove on at least one of its end faces in the stacking direction, wherein the groove surrounds the anode space and the cathode space at least partially.

Title: BIOELECTRICAL PROCESS CONTROL AND METHODS OF USE THEREOF
Abstract: This invention is directed to the control of processes for stable, high performance of bioelectrochemical systems. disclosed are methods for preparing bioelectrochemical systems (BESs), including establishing a biofilm while actively controlling and maintaining a cell voltage. Also disclosed are methods and systems for active, ongoing manual or automated control of BESs by removing excess biofilm, and measuring the presence of same.

Title: Core/shell-vacancy engineering (CSVE) of catalysts for electrochemical CO2 reduction
Abstract: The invention relates to a catalyst system for electrocatalyzing conversion of CO2 into multi-carbon hydrocarbons and/or alcohols, and to the method to produce it. The catalyst comprises a core-shell structure comprising a core that is composed of metal sulphide and a shell that is composed of a metal with vacancies.

Title: PRODUCTION OF GRAFT-POLYMERIZED MEMBRANE
Abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the formation of a graft-polymerized membrane useful as an intermediate for the production of a variety of diaphragms used in electrolysis of salt, fuel cells, etc., by irradiating an inert polymer film with an ionizing radiation and contacting the irradiated film with alpha,beta,beta-trifluorostyrene. CONSTITUTION:An inert polymer film (e.g., polyethylene film or polytetrafluoroethylene film) is irradiated with an ionizing radiation (e.g., electron beams) at a dose of about 1-30Mrad. The obtained film is immersed in a solution of alpha,beta,beta-trifluorostyrene (TFS) or coated with TFS to effect a reaction therebetween at about 10-90 deg.C for about 1-50hr. The obtained graft-polymerized membrane can have desired properties by introducing desired substituents into the benzene ring of TFS as a graft chain, for example, cation exchange membrane by introduction of sulfonic acid groups, anion exchange membrane by introduction of amino groups, and neutral membrane by introduction of hydroxyl groups.

Title: Solid electrolyte electrolytic tank device adopting anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrolysis, and discloses a solid electrolyte electrolytic tank device adopting an anion exchange membrane. The device comprises a tank body, wherein an anode and a cathode are installed on the left side and the right side in a tank body cavity correspondingly, a diaphragm is fixedly installed in the middle in the tank body cavity, guide mechanisms are arranged between the anode and the diaphragm and between the cathode and the diaphragm correspondingly, and the guide mechanism comprises a waterproof motor and a shield. According to the solid electrolyte electrolytic tank device adopting the anion exchange membrane, when a threaded bush moves up and down on a threaded column in a reciprocating mode, a limiting rod B and a limiting rod A move up and down in a reciprocating mode, rotation of the threaded bush drives a rotating plate to rotate, rotation of the rotating plate drives a fan plate to rotate, and the rotation of the fan plate realizes the stirring of a liquid in the tank body cavity to accelerate the passing of the liquid through the diaphragm, so that the liquid in the tank body cavity can be in better contact with the anode and the cathode, and the reaction efficiency is accelerated.
Applicants: SICHUAN DIWEI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Pendulum type electrolysis device
Abstract: The invention provides a pendulum type electrolysis device which comprises a first electrolytic tank, a flow field plate and a second electrolytic tank, the flow field plate is arranged between the first electrolytic tank and the second electrolytic tank, and a flow channel is formed in the flow field plate; the first electrolytic tank comprises a first electrolytic chamber, a first working electrode, a first counter electrode and a first ion exchange membrane, an inner cavity of the first electrolytic chamber is divided into a first chamber and a second chamber by the first ion exchange membrane, and the second chamber is communicated with the runner; the second electrolytic tank comprises a second electrolytic chamber, a second working electrode, a second counter electrode and a second ion exchange membrane, an inner cavity of the second electrolytic chamber is divided into a third chamber and a fourth chamber by the second ion exchange membrane, and the third chamber is communicated with the runner; one of the first ion exchange membrane and the second ion exchange membrane is a proton exchange membrane, and the other one is an anion exchange membrane. The pendulum type electrolysis device can improve the conversion rate of electrochemical reaction.

Title: Platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound as well as rapid high-throughput preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound as well as a rapid high-flux preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, fully ultrasonically mixing a metal salt precursor, an inorganic auxiliary reagent and carbon black, freeze-drying the mixed solution, and then carrying out short-time Joule heating treatment to prepare the carbon-loaded platinum-rare earth-based intermetallic compound catalyst. Compared with reported preparation methods such as a physical metallurgy method and an electric arc melting method, the method has the advantages that the platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound catalyst can be rapidly prepared at high flux, the prepared intermetallic compound is uniformly distributed on the surface of carbon black and is uniform in size and small in particle size, the problem of agglomeration of nano-particles is avoided, and meanwhile the platinum-rare earth based intermetallic compound catalyst has the advantages of being stable in structure, high in stability and the like. And the composite material has multiple active sites, shows excellent electrocatalytic activity on cathode hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system, and has considerable energy application potential.

Title: AEM electrolytic cell membrane electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an AEM electrolytic cell membrane electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, the membrane electrode comprises: an anode comprising an anode catalyst growing on a porous metal substrate in situ; the cathode comprises a cathode catalyst and a cathode diffusion layer; the anion exchange membrane is arranged between the anode catalyst and the cathode catalyst; and the cathode catalyst is loaded on the cathode side of the anion exchange membrane. The self-supporting anode is formed in an in-situ growth mode, so that the self-supporting anode has the effects of being stable in performance, good in conductivity, not prone to falling off and the like, gas diffusion is guaranteed, active sites are provided for oxidation reaction, a gas diffusion layer does not need to be considered for the anode when an electrolytic cell is assembled, and assembling is easy and convenient; the cathode catalyst is sprayed on the anion exchange membrane, and the advantages of the CCM are combined, so that the mass transfer path of the cathode is reduced, the ohmic polarization is reduced, and the electrolytic efficiency is improved.
Applicants: ANQING BRANCH GUANGDONG POLYROCKS CHEMICAL CO LTD

Title: Oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode for AEMWE and preparation method of oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention aims at providing an oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode for AEMWE and a preparation method of the oxygen-containing anion modified oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water. Introducing a second cation and an oxygen-containing anion through dipping treatment; and finally, carrying out cyclic voltammetry electrochemical activation treatment to obtain the oxygen evolution electrode modified by the oxygen-containing anion. The invention provides an AEMWE anode gas diffusion electrode preparation route which is rapid, controllable, simple in method and relatively mild in synthesis condition, the oxygen evolution electrode prepared by the method has high activity and long-term durability under ampere-level current density, and has low cell pressure and long-term stability under AEMWE industrial conditions; the catalyst cost and the hydrogen production energy consumption are effectively reduced. The preparation method is suitable for cheap iron-based metal materials, different oxygen-containing anions can be introduced, and the preparation method has huge potential application value and wide application prospects.
Applicants: UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;;SHANXI RES INSTITUTE HUAIROU LABORATORY

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolysis device
Abstract: The utility model discloses an anion-exchange membrane electrolysis device which adopts an anion-exchange membrane as an electrolyte and can use pure water or a low-concentration alkaline solution as an electrolyte, so that the problems that the electrolyte in alkaline electrolyzed water blocks a catalyst layer, gas is crossed and the like are solved. According to the anion exchange membrane electrolysis device, the membrane electrode assembly is prepared by adopting a CCS process, so that the close combination of a catalyst liquid and an anion exchange membrane can be realized, and the utilization rate and the electrochemical performance of a catalyst are improved; according to the anion exchange membrane electrolysis device, a nickel oxide coating is coated with graphene oxide to serve as an anode catalyst, the activity and stability of an oxygen evolution reaction can be improved, and the use amount and cost of a noble metal catalyst are reduced; the temperature of the electrolytic cell can be effectively controlled, and safe operation of the electrolytic cell is guaranteed.
Applicants: BEIJING YONGQING ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

Title: Nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis and gassing, in particular to a nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode comprises a nickel-selenium-based electrocatalyst and a conductive current collector, the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is of a three-dimensional structure integrating a self-supporting micro-nano array mesh structure and a mesh conductive current collector, wherein the self-supporting micro-nano array mesh structure is assembled by secondary crosslinking of nanosheets, and the preparation method of the nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode comprises the step of in-situ growth of a nickel-selenium-based electrocatalyst on the mesh conductive current collector. The prepared nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is used for preparing hydrogen by decomposing water in alkaline and anion exchange membranes or seawater electrolysis cells. The nickel-selenium-based mesh electrode is of a three-dimensional structure, the three-dimensional mesh structure has high specific surface area and rich pores, has excellent mass transfer and bubble transfer characteristics, relieves concentration polarization, improves reaction efficiency, and provides a new thought for a new generation of electrolytic cell electrode design.

Title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR THE PRODUCTION OF HYDROXIDES
Abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for preparing Ca(OH)2 and/or Mg(OH)2.

Title: Method for preparing high-purity carbonate by using calcium and magnesium-rich solution to mineralize CO2
Abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing a high-purity carbonate by using a calcium and magnesium-rich solution to mineralize CO2. The main contents are as follows: placing an anion exchange membrane into an electrolytic bath, dividing the electrolytic bath into an anode region and a cathode region, adding a conductive solution into the anode region as an anolyte, adding a calcium and magnesium-rich conductive solution into the cathode region as a catholyte and an electrolysis reaction raw material and applying direct current between an anode electrode and a cathode electrode. OH<-1> and Mg<2+> in a cathode solution are combined to generate an Mg(OH)2 precipitate. Mg(OH)2 is placed into a reactor added with water, CO2 gas is introduced, when the solution becomes a clarified magnesium hydrogen carbonate solution, the introduction of CO2 is stropped, the reaction temperature is increased till the precipitation of a large number of solids, and a solid phase is separated and dried to obtain basic magnesium carbonate. The calcium-rich solution is re-added into the cathode region, CO2 is introduced into the cathode region while applying the direct current, CO2 is converted to CO3<2-> which rapidly reacts with Ca<2+> to generate a CaCO3 precipitate, and solids produced in the cathode region after electrolysis reaction are moved out, filtered and dried to obtain calcium carbonate.

Title: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system
Abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system. The system comprises an electrolytic bath, a water replenishing unit, a condensing unit, a collecting unit and a controller, and oxygen generated by the electrolytic bath is discharged out after passing through a raw material water tank and an oxygen-water separator in the water replenishing unit under normal pressure; hydrogen generated by the electrolytic cell is subjected to secondary treatment through a hydrogen separator and a hydrogen-water separator in the collecting unit, then is pressurized by a back pressure valve in the collecting unit and then is output, and a differential pressure type system on the two sides of hydrogen and oxygen is formed; the raw material water tank in the water replenishing unit can realize automatic feeding, and the starting and stopping of the circulating pump and the electrolytic bath in the water replenishing unit are controlled by the liquid level in the raw material water tank, so that the full-automatic feeding, circulating and electrolysis control is realized, the intelligent degree of hydrogen production by water electrolysis is greatly improved, the risk of manual regulation and control is reduced, and meanwhile, the miniaturization effect of hydrogen production equipment is achieved.

Title: Electrolytic cell and processes for producing alkali hydroxide and hydrogen peroxide
Abstract: The electrolytic cell 1 for producing alkali hydroxide or hydrogen peroxide is divided into the anode compartment 3 and the cathode compartment 4 by the cation exchange membrane 2. The cathode compartment 4 is further divided by the anion exchange membrane 6 into the solution compartment 7 containing a concentrated aqueous solution of alkali hydroxide and the gas compartment accommodating the gas cathode 8. The anion exchange membrane 6 prevents the gas cathode 8 from coming into direct or indirect contact with the aqueous solution of alkali hydroxide. This leads to the extended life of the gas cathode. The above-mentioned arrangement is effective in large-sized electrolytic cells. Thus, the present invention can be applied to industrial electrolysis which has never been achieved with the conventional gas electrode.

Title: Half CCM Apparatus and Method for Manufacturing a Membrane Electrode Assembly for Water Electrolysis Forming a Half CCM Structure Based on a Hydrocarbon-Based Anion Exchange Membrane
Abstract: 탄화수소계 음이온교환막 기반 Half CCM 구조를 형성하는 수전해용 막전극접합체 제조 장치 및 동작 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수전해용 막전극접합체 제조 장치는 귀금속 촉매와 이오노머를 포함하는 HER(Cathode)용 촉매 슬러리를 생성하는 촉매 슬러리 생성부, 상기 촉매 슬러리를 이형 기재 상에 코팅하여 HER 전극층을 형성하는 전극 코팅부, 탄화수소계 음이온 교환막을 가압 상태에서 건조하여 상기 탄화수소계 음이온 교환막의 평탄도를 유지하는 막 전처리부, 상기 막 전처리부에 의해 전처리된 탄화수소계 음이온 교환막의 일면에 상기 HER 전극층을 배치하고, 압력 및 온도를 인가하여 전사(Decal Transfer) 공정을 통해 상기 HER 전극층을 상기 탄화수소계 음이온 교환막의 표면에 접합하는 전사 접합부 및 상기 막 전처리부에 의해 수행되는 가압 건조 상태에 기초하여 상기 전사 접합부의 전사 공정이 수행되도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

Title: ELECTROLYTIC BUFFER GENERATOR
Abstract: Buffer generators are described based on electrodialytic devices. The methods of using these devices can generate buffers for diverse applications, including separations, e.g., HPLC and ion chromatography. Also provided are chromatographic devices including the buffer generators, generally located upstream from a chromatography column, sample injector valve or both.
Applicants: DASGUPTA PURNENDU K;;CHEN YONGJING;;SRINIVASAN KANNAN;;DIONEX CORP;;UNIV TEXAS

Title: Integrated photoelectrochemical cell and system having a solid polymer electrolyte
Abstract: A photoelectrochemical (PEC) cell includes a photovoltaic electrode that generates voltage under radiation; a solid membrane electrode assembly that includes at least one solid polymer electrolyte and first and second electrodes; a mechanism that collect gases from oxidation and reduction reactions; and an electrical connection between the photovoltaic electrode and the solid membrane electrode assembly. A PEC system and a method of making such PEC cell and PEC system are also disclosed.

Title: ELECTROCHEMICAL METAL DEPOSITION SYSTEM AND METHOD
Abstract: An electrochemical deposition apparatus and method for the selective recovery of metal. The electrochemical deposition apparatus comprises a porous cathodic material, an anode, an inter-electrode region formed by the anode and cathode, and a gas release channel. The method may comprise passing a solution comprising a metal into a cavity, changing an oxidation state of a metal, and selectively depositing the metal onto a porous cathodic material. The electrochemical deposition apparatus may recover metal from metal feed in the form of metal hydroxides. The recovered metal may be from any source including, but not limited to, minerals, electronic waste, and black mass.

Title: Active foamed nickel anode and activation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses an active foamed nickel anode and an activation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production through water electrolysis. The activation method comprises the following steps: carrying out a reaction on pretreated foamed nickel and a solid phosphorus-containing precursor in a non-direct contact manner, introducing inert gas, exhausting air, carrying out programmed heating calcination activation, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the active foamed nickel anode. The method is simple in process, remarkable in effect and suitable for large-scale production, the specific surface area of the catalyst can be greatly increased, the water electrolysis oxygen evolution (OER) performance of the foamed nickel is enhanced, and the method can be directly applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis in an alkaline or anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

Title: PROCESSES FOR PREPARING LITHIUM HYDROXIDE
Abstract: There is provided a system for preparing lithium hydroxide. The system comprises:an electrolysis cell, defining an anodic compartment separated from a central compartment by an anion exchange membrane and a cathodic compartment separated from said central compartment by a cation exchange membrane. The central compartment comprising at least one inlet for receiving an aqueous composition comprising lithium compound. The cathodic compartment comprises at least one cathode wherein said cathode is configured to produce a lithium hydroxide-enriched aqueous composition. A pH probe and at least one inlet for receiving acid or base for at least substantially maintaining the pH of said aqueous composition comprising said lithium compound at about 1 to about 4 is also provided.

Title: Self-generating coupling waste battery lithium recovery and flue gas carbon capture system and method
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of resource recycling and carbon capture, and particularly discloses a self-power-generation coupled waste battery lithium recovery and flue gas carbon capture system and method. The system comprises a flow battery separated by an anion exchange membrane, the negative electrode side is provided with a waste lithium iron phosphate pole piece and an electrolyte chamber, and the positive electrode side is provided with a metal-based catalyst and a gas chamber. The method comprises the following steps: directly taking a waste pole piece as a negative electrode, and performing oxidation reaction under the driving of potential difference to release lithium ions; meanwhile, flue gas is introduced into the positive electrode side, oxygen is reduced on the surface of the catalyst to generate hydroxyl radicals, and then CO2 is captured and converted into carbonate radicals; and the carbonate is migrated to the negative electrode side to be combined with lithium ions to generate lithium carbonate. Self power generation is achieved based on the potential difference of positive electrode oxygen reduction and negative electrode lithium oxidation, an external power source is not needed, efficient recovery of lithium resources and carbon capture of flue gas are synchronously completed, and the method has the advantages of being simple in process, low in cost and environmentally friendly.

Title: FUEL CELL TYPE REACTION APPARATUS
Abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fuel cell type reaction apparatus which highly selectively, efficiently and economically produces a valuable compound in a mild condition and an electric power as needed; and also to provide a method for producing the valuable compound with the use of the fuel cell type reaction apparatus, and particularly, a method for producing hydrogen peroxide from hydrogen and oxygen.

SOLUTION: The fuel cell type reaction apparatus comprises a three-tank structure having an intermediate chamber formed between the inner side of an anode 4 and the inner side of a cathode 5, an anode chamber 1 in the outer side of the anode 4, and a cathode chamber 3 in the outer side of the cathode 5, wherein the intermediate chamber is partitioned into an intermediate chamber 2A in a cathode side and an intermediate chamber 2B in an anode side by an anion exchange membrane 12, and an electrolyte solution is introduced into the intermediate chamber 2A in the cathode side and the intermediate chamber 2B in the anode side. The cathode 5 is a catalyst electrode containing a metal complex having porphyrin or phthalocyanine-based macrocyclic ligand and a conductive carbon material. The method for producing the compound and the method for producing hydrogen peroxide employ the above reaction apparatus.

Title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR COATING A COMPONENT OR SEMI-FINISHED PRODUCT WITH A CHROMIUM LAYER
Abstract: The invention relates to a device for coating a component or semi-finished product with a chromium layer, the device comprising an undivided deposition cell, in which there is an anode and which is suitable for receiving a cathodically connected component, wherein: there is an electrolyte solution containing chromium(II) in the deposition cell; the device has an electrolytic cell, which is divided by a membrane disposed in the electrolytic cell into a cathode chamber, in which there is a cathode, and an anode chamber, in which there is an anode; the cathode chamber is connected to the deposition cell by means of a line and a pump disposed in the line; the pump can pump liquid from the cathode chamber into the deposition cell and/or can pump liquid from the deposition cell into the cathode chamber.

Title: Preparation method of potassium formate
Abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing potassium formate through electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide. The method sequentially comprises the steps of preparation of a working electrode and an anode, assembly of a gas diffusion electrolytic tank and electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide. The preparation process is carried out in a gas diffusion electrode electrolytic tank, a catalyst is sprayed on a gas diffusion electrode to serve as a working electrode, high-purity carbon dioxide and a potassium hydroxide aqueous solution are continuously introduced into a cathode to serve as electrolyte, and the cathode and the anode are isolated by an anion exchange membrane. An electrochemical performance test is carried out in a three-electrode system, a potassium formate aqueous solution is finally obtained in a cathode chamber, a potassium formate solid product can be obtained after separation and purification, and the gas diffusion electrode greatly improves the mass transfer capacity of carbon dioxide, enhances the production efficiency of potassium formate and has great process value.
Applicants: WUHAN INST OF MARINE ELECTRIC PROPULSION CHINA SHIPBUILDING GROUP CORPORATION NO 712 INST

Title: High-entropy oxide electrocatalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials, particularly relates to an electrocatalytic anode oxygen evolution reaction catalyst based on an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, and particularly relates to a high-entropy oxide electrocatalyst and a preparation method thereof. The high-entropy oxide electrocatalyst is composed of five metal elements of Ni, Co, Fe, Mn and Al, is loaded on a foamed nickel substrate, has a nanosheet structure, is rich in oxygen vacancies on the surface, has excellent electrochemical catalysis performance and stability, and is suitable for electrocatalysis of an electrolytic water anode side in an alkaline environment. According to the preparation method of the high-entropy oxide electrocatalyst, foamed nickel is used as a substrate, salts of five metals of Ni, Co, Fe, Mn and Al which are equal in mole are subjected to hydrothermal synthesis to form a precursor, and then the high-entropy oxide electrocatalyst is prepared through self-etching, annealing oxidation and acid etching, and the high-entropy oxide electrocatalyst is easy and convenient to operate, good in repeatability, controllable in cost, excellent in performance and suitable for large-scale production.

Title: Ion-Selective Capacitive Deionization Composite Electrode, and Method for Manufacturing a Module
Abstract: Provided are a CDI electrode and a method for manufacturing a module using the same. A composite electrode manufactured by the manufacturing method of the present invention can manufacture a CDI electrode capable of increasing adsorption efficiency and rate of ions and selectively adsorbing cation and anion, thereby simply and inexpensively manufacturing the CDI electrode module without using a cation-exchange membrane and an anion-exchange membrane.
Applicants: KANG KYUNG SEOK;;SON WON KEUN;;CHOI JAE HWAN;;PARK NAM SOO;;KIM TAE IL;;SION TECH CO LTD

Title: AN ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYZER COMPRISING THE METAL NANOCRYSTAL ELECTRODEPOSITED SUPER-HYDROPHILIC TiO2-BASED NANOTUBE ELECTRODE AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
Abstract: 본 발명은 금속 나노입자가 전착된 초친수성 티타늄 산화물 나노튜브 전극에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 간단한 전기산화법 및 전착법을 통해 금속 나노입자가 전착된 초친수성 티타늄 산화물 나노튜브기반 전극의 제조방법에 관한 것이다.

Title: Preparation method of bipolar membrane for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bipolar membrane for hydrogen production through electrolysis of water, and relates to the field of hydrogen production through electrolysis of water. In the process of preparing a bipolar composite membrane, a metal thin material with a microcosmic porous cavity structure is added to a middle layer, on one hand, water can have better smoothness when being introduced into the middle of the bipolar composite membrane through the cavity structure; on the other hand, due to the porous structure, hydrogen ions and hydroxyl ions dissociated under the action of an electric field when water passes through can penetrate through the middle metal sheet, and transmission paths are provided for the hydrogen ions to go to the proton exchange membrane and the hydroxyl ions to go to the anion exchange membrane. In the process of hydrogen production through water electrolysis, only water needs to be introduced in the middle, meanwhile, the proton exchange membrane serves as a cathode, the anion exchange membrane serves as an anode, no catalyst exists in the middle, and meanwhile water splitting and hydrogen conversion are completed only under low voltage.
Applicants: SHANGHAI QINGQI SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

Title: Electrochemical cell
Abstract: In the electrochemical cell comprising a housing in which two diffusion electrodes are arranged which contain active catalyst particles and at whose rears in each case a contiguous compartment for a gas is provided, a compartment for a liquid electrolyte being provided between the diffusion electrodes, there is arranged, between the diffusion electrodes, at least one anion exchanger membrane directly in front of one of the diffusion electrodes.

Title: A FLOW FIELD PLATE, AN ELECTROLYSIS CELL, AN ELECTROLYTIC DEVICE AND METHODS FOR PREPARING THE ELECTRODE, THE ELECTROLYSIS CELL AND THE ELECTROLYTIC DEVICE
Abstract: A flow field plate comprising a conductive insert comprising a flow channel pattern and a frame plate comprising on one or both sides a pocket configured to receive the insert. An electrolysis cell comprising a membrane electrode assembly comprising an anode combined with the flow field plate, a cathode combined with the flow field plate, and an ion exchange membrane between the anode and the cathode, wherein one or more of the flow field plates comprises a conductive insert comprising a flow channel pattern and a frame plate comprising on one or both sides a pocket configured to receive the insert. An electrolytic device comprising one or more of the flow field plates or one or more of the electrolysis cells. A method for preparing a flow field plate, an electrolysis cell and an electrolytic device.

Title: WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYSIS PROMOTER AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE USING THE SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to a catalysis promoter dissolved in an electrolyte of a water electrolysis device using an alkaline electrolyte and promoting the catalytic activity of an oxygen evolution electrode.

Title: Hydrogen production electrolytic tank and water electrolysis device
Abstract: The utility model provides a hydrogen production electrolytic bath and a water electrolysis device. The hydrogen production electrolytic bath comprises an anion exchange membrane, a water storage tank and a water storage tank, the at least two diffusion layers are positioned on two opposite sides of the anion exchange membrane; and the catalyst is formed between the anion exchange membrane and the diffusion layer, the catalyst comprises a nano-chain microstructure, and the nano-chain microstructure is formed by stacking nano-particles. According to the hydrogen production electrolytic tank and the water electrolysis device, the catalytic efficiency can be improved, and the energy consumption can be reduced.
Applicants: SUZHOU JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD;;SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Process for preparing an alkanolammonium salt or ammonium salt of surface active agents
Abstract: A novel process for preparing an alkanolammonium salt or ammonium salt of an amino acid surface active agent or an acylated amino acid surface active agent. In the process, an alkali metal salt of an amino acid surface active agent or acylated amino acid surface active agent is subjected to electrodialysis in the presence of a mineral acid salt of an alkanolamine or ammonia, or a mixture of an alkanolamine or ammonia and a mineral acid. By-products which are produced during the preparation of the above surface active agents can be mostly removed to outside during the electrodialysis and are thus purified conveniently.

Title: MICROBIAL ELECTROLYSIS CELLS AND METHODS FOR THE PRODUCTION OF CHEMICAL PRODUCTS
Abstract: A microbial electrolysis cell having a brush anode is described. A method of producing products, such as hydrogen, at the cathode of the microbial electrolysis cell is also provided. The microbial electrolysis cell is configured in a cylindrical shape having an anode, cathode and anion exchange membrane all disposed concentrically. A brush anode spirally wound around the outside of the cylindrical microbial electrolysis cell is described. The method may include sparging the anode and/or cathode with air in some cases. In addition, CO2-containing gas may be injected into a cathode chamber to reduce pH is some cases.
Applicants: ARIZONA SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ENTPR LLC

Title: METHOD FOR SEPARATING ACID AND ALKALI FROM AQUEOUS SOLUTION OF SALT
Abstract: PURPOSE:To separate and recover acids and alkalis of high concentration from aqueous solution of various salts, by using a fluorine anion-exchange membrane into which anion exchange group is introduced after the treatment with acid or base of a carboxylate membrane comprising copolymers of repeating unit represented by a specific formula. CONSTITUTION:One or both sides of a membrane of carboxylic ester represented by the formula are treated with acid or base and dried under reduced pressure. Then said membrane is made to react with dimethylamine etc. to be converted to a carboxylic acid amide membrane which is converted to an amine membrane by means of a reducing agent. By causing an alkylation agent to react with said amine membrane, a fluorine anion-exchange membrane having a quaternary ammonium group is obtained Said membrane is used as a diaphragm between an anode chamber and an intermediate chamber of an electrolytic bath, while a fluorine cation-exchange membrane being usd as a diaphragm between the intermediate chamber and a cathode chamber. Aqueous solution of salt such as that of NaNO3 etc. is supplied to the interme diate chamber where electrolysis is performed, causing acids such as nitric acid, etc., to be produced in the anode chamber, while alkalis such as NaOH, etc., in the cathode chamber.

Title: ELECTROLYSIS SYSTEM AND ELECTROLYSIS METHOD FOR THE SAME
Abstract: The present invention provides an electrolysis system and an electrolysis method for the same in which non-purified water containing a trace amount of alkali earth metal ions, such as calcium ion and magnesium ion is applied as raw material, having a configuration in which the raw material water is supplied to the cathode compartment (1), featuring that scale of the alkali earth metals including hydroxide can be prevented from depositing on the surface of the cathode (2) provided in the cathode compartment (1). The present invention prevents scales of hydroxide and others of the alkali earth metal from depositing on the cathode surface (2), by covering the substantially entire surface of the cathode (2) with the cation exchange resin-contained, alkali earth metal scale-preventive film in the electrolysis system having a configuration comprising a diaphragm (5), an anode compartment (3) separated by the diaphragm (5), a cathode compartment (1) separated by the diaphragm (5), an anode (4) provided in the anode compartment (3), a cathode (2) provided in the cathode compartment (1), and raw material water containing alkali earth metal ions supplied to the cathode compartment
Applicants: AQUAECOS LTD;;PERMELEC ELECTRODE LTD;;NITTA HIDEO;;HOSONUMA MASASHI;;FUKUSHIMA YASUNORI;;OBINATA RYOJIN

Title: Ultralow-energy-consumption carbon dioxide electrochemical trapping method and system
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemistry, and particularly relates to an ultralow-energy-consumption CO2 electrochemical trapping system. The system comprises an anode region, a cathode region and an anion exchange membrane arranged between the anode region and the cathode region, wherein the cathode region is filled with alkali liquor; a water-soluble organic photon coupled electron transfer (PCET) reactant is added into the anode region, and an external power supply is communicated between the anode region and the cathode region. The external power supply provides electric energy for the electrolytic cell. The cathode side is a hydrogen evolution electrode, and electrochemical reduction reaction is carried out to decompose water to generate H2 and OH <->; h < + > electrochemically generated on the anode side reacts with HCO3 <-> in anode liquor in a CO2 desorption tower to generate high-purity CO2 and water, so that purification desorption of CO2 is realized, and a substance Q rich in an organic PCET oxidation state enters a reduction regeneration tower for non-electrochemical reduction regeneration. The system can stably operate under low energy consumption, can capture CO2 in flue gas, and can also be applied to capture CO2 in factory waste gas, transportation tail gas, atmosphere and other environments.

Title: PRODUCTION OF BIPOLAR MEMBRANE
Abstract: PURPOSE:To facilitate the production of a bipolar membrane small in the rise of the decomposition voltage of water and high in the efficiency of electrolysis of water by introducing cation-exchange groups into the surface of an anion exchange membrane and bonding a cation exchange membrane thereto. CONSTITUTION:Cation exchange groups are introduced into an anion exchange membrane, desirably one having an alkali-resistant quat. ammonium salt group. For example, this introduction process comprises making a membraneous polymer based on chloromethylstyrene, divinylbenzene and styrene, sulfonating its surface with sulfuric acid to introduce cationic groups thereinto and reacting the chloromethyl groups present in the inside with trimethylamine. The obtained anion exchange membrane is bonded to a cation exchange membrane with an adhesive to obtain a bipolar membrane. This bipolar membrane is useful in the process for producing an acid and an alkali from an aqueous solution of a salt.

Title: Method for preparing hydrofluoric acid by recovering fluosilicic acid
Abstract: The invention belongs to the field of electrochemistry, and particularly relates to a method for preparing hydrofluoric acid by recovering fluosilicic acid. The method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing an electrolytic tank which comprises an anode region and a cathode region, the cathode region and the anode region are respectively provided with an inert cathode and an inert anode, the anode region and the cathode region are separated by an anion exchange membrane, ammonia water is poured into the cathode region to serve as a catholyte, a hydrogen sulfide aqueous solution serves as an electrolyte in the anode region, and an electrolysis system is constructed; and 2) controlling the electrolysis system to be electrified for electrolysis, slowly adding a fluosilicic acid solution into the catholyte in the cathode region, supplementing hydrogen sulfide gas into the electrolyte in the anode region, and recovering the electrolyte in the anode region after electrolysis, namely a hydrofluoric acid aqueous solution. According to the method, the high-purity hydrogen fluoride is prepared through the controllable electrochemical reaction, the hydrogen fluoride obtained after water removal has the purity of 99% or above, the yield of the product can reach 70% or above, the whole process is safe and controllable, and the energy consumption is obviously lower than that of an existing process.
Applicants: FUJIAN LONGFU NEW MAT CO LTD

Title: Multi-branched polymer, preparation method thereof, anion exchange membrane and alkaline electrolysis device
Abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of polymer functional materials, and provides a multi-element branched polymer, a preparation method thereof, an anion exchange membrane and an alkaline electrolysis device. The multi-element branched polymer in the embodiment of the invention comprises a first chain segment, a second chain segment and a third chain segment, wherein a linking group is also arranged in the chain segment. The multi-element branched polymer in the embodiment of the invention is at least beneficial to improving the conductivity, the water absorption performance, the alkaline stability and the mechanical strength of the anion exchange membrane.

Title: ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE COMPRISING CROSS-LINKED POLYMER OF SEBS AND POLYFLUORENE, AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SAME
Abstract: The present invention relates to an anion exchange membrane comprising a cross-linked polymer in which polyfluorene is cross-linked with styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBS). The anion exchange membrane according to the present invention has excellent mechanical properties and thermal stability while having high ionic conductivity, and can be applied to a water electrolysis device.

Title: Rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operating power
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrolytic cells, and particularly discloses a rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operation power, the rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a square current collecting end plate and a mounting plate which are arranged in parallel, a plurality of small electrolysis chambers are arranged between the current collecting end plate and the mounting plate in series, and current collecting blocks are arranged at the tops of polar plates of the small electrolysis chambers; the plurality of current collecting blocks are arranged in a row along the transverse direction; a rack stretching across the top of the electrolysis chamber is arranged at the tops of the current collecting end plate and the mounting plate through connecting lugs, a gear sliding block mechanism is arranged on the rack, and a sliding contact block connected with the current collecting end plate through a wire is arranged on the gear sliding block mechanism; the number of the small electrolysis chambers in the actual operation process is adjusted by changing the position of a gear sliding block mechanism on the upper portion of the electrolytic cell, then the hydrogen production rate and the consumed power of the electrolytic cell are adjusted, the fluctuation electric power of a power grid is adapted, and energy loss is reduced.
Applicants: SHAANXI QINGNENG POWER TECH CO LTD

Title: MOLECULAR ELECTROCATALYTIC SYSTEMS AND METHODS THEREOF
Abstract: Molecular electrocatalytic systems for ammonia production from wastewater nitrate are described. The electrocatalytic systems use ammonia-selective homogeneous molecular NOsRR catalysts in real wastewater.

Title: METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST
Abstract: The present invention relates to a copper-nickel-iron double layer hydroxide nanoprism, a manufacturing method thereof, and a use thereof as a water electrolysis catalyst. The present invention discloses a catalytic electrode for water electrolysis, the catalytic electrode comprising: a metal foam; and a composite transition metal chalcogenide heterostructure formed on the metal foam. This catalytic electrode for water electrolysis can exhibit improved electrochemical catalytic activity for both a hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and an oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in a water electrolysis reaction, can efficiently produce hydrogen with a lower energy supply than conventional noble metal electrodes, and can be used in both anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers and solar cell-water electrolysis systems. The present invention relates to a nanosphere hybrid structure containing nickel cobalt selenide and molybdenum selenide, and a use thereof as a water electrolysis catalyst. The present invention relates to a water electrolysis catalyst in which zinc cobalt sulfide and molybdenum disulfide are hetero-bonded, and a manufacturing method thereof.
